wire.headline: Energy firm reports profit drop and plans significant job cuts
sentences: Revenue increased by 7% year-on-year to reach 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit decreased by 12% to stand at 310m GBP.
The company will cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants are scheduled to close by March 2027, with one location in Wales and another in Kent.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend will be held steady at 12.4p per share.
Shares fell by 4.2% during morning trading.
